definitions.S0: Count of frozen semantic-responsibility surfaces changed for the initial AIChat-NG treatment, relative to the common donor plus byte-identical neutral scaffold.
definitions.L0: Normalized non-test source churn for the initial treatment.
definitions.Q0: Initial frozen functional-oracle validity; binary gate, not a compensatory score.
definitions.S1: Count of frozen semantic-responsibility surfaces changed by the one-shot follow-up, measured from each arm's sealed E1 state.
definitions.L1: Normalized non-test source churn for the one-shot follow-up.
definitions.Q1: Post-follow-up frozen functional-oracle validity; binary gate, not a compensatory score.

surface_count_rule: Count a catalog surface at most once per phase when the phase requires a semantic edit to that responsibility. File count and line count do not define S.

include: manually maintained build/source manifests required by the treatment
exclude: generated files regenerated mechanically from a source-of-truth generator
normalized_churn_rule.symmetry: The same inclusion/exclusion rule is applied to both arms and both phases.

validity_rule: Any Q=0 prevents structural-cost interpretation for that phase; lower S or L cannot compensate for invalid behavior.
reveal_rule: No raw coordinate is revealed until both arms have sealed initial and follow-up measurement receipts and Q1 has been adjudicated for both.
